description.zh: 输入任一观点或议题，通过第一性原理、双重解释、反向工程与极限平衡四重视角深度剖析认知盲区。支持持久化历史记录。
description.en: Dismantle cognitive blind spots through First-Principles, Dual-Explanation, Reverse-Engineering, and Extreme Boundary tests. Supports persistent history.

releaseNotes.zh: v1.0.3: 接入 Cherry.storage 持久化双轨存储，彻底解决重启或刷新后历史沉淀丢失问题；规范包内安全哈希。
releaseNotes.en: v1.0.3: Added Cherry.storage dual-track persistence to preserve thinking history across reboots.
